checks.money: BigInt minor-unit arithmetic for payment/payout settlement; PostgreSQL NUMERIC persisted records
checks.ledger: Payments, requests, payout jobs and referral records persist; browser writes and admin direct balance edits blocked
checks.idempotency: Durable per-account checkout attempt references, unique payout claims, provider keys, duplicate credit RPC guards
checks.concurrency: Concurrent HTTP checkout/payout attacks tested; PGlite is isolated single-process PostgreSQL and does not establish multi-connection production capacity
checks.webhooks: Raw signatures, duplicate/delayed/out-of-order events, read lag, and terminal payout states tested
checks.verification: Server provider readback and exact amount/currency/reference matching; incomplete/underpaid payments rejected
checks.authorization: Ownership, confirmed allowlisted admin role and service-only financial RPC tests
checks.secrets: Source scan passes; provider diagnostics and malformed bodies are not logged verbatim
checks.limits: Bounded inbound/outbound concurrency, dedicated webhook limit, request complexity/size limits, public AI/feedback request limits
checks.audit: Durable payment/request/payout records plus structured credit logs; external log retention not verified
checks.reconciliation: Read-only CLI compares latest 50 hosted checkouts, involved account contribution totals and unfinished payout jobs
checks.failures: Injected database failure rolls back all credit changes; uncertain transfers/checkouts are reserved for reconciliation rather than resent

localLoad.limitation: Public config and health endpoints on local production build; excludes provider/database latency

frontendDevelopmentAdvisories.note: braces latest 3.0.3 is still affected; postcss-selector-parser update requires a separate compatibility upgrade

remaining.hosting: Last supplied Render configuration is Free. Use a paid always-on instance and stage database/provider load testing before increasing traffic.
remaining.rateLimits: In-memory instance limits do not provide distributed bot protection; configure platform WAF and shared limiter before horizontal scaling.
remaining.auth: Login/OTP go directly to Supabase; project rate-limit/CAPTCHA/MFA settings require dashboard verification.
remaining.recovery: Verify database backups/PITR and perform a restore drill; external log retention and alerting need configuration.
remaining.automation: No cron credentials created or automatic payouts/debits activated by this work.
remaining.coverage: Not a third-party penetration test, disaster recovery certification, or proof of unlimited traffic capacity; live saved-card debit/bank delivery not exercised.
